verdict.rationale: SumUp provides documented sandbox merchant accounts, test cards, and simulated payment flows (including 3D Secure, success/failure) explicitly for testing without touching production data, and even ties this to Virtual Solo for reader testing before switching to physical devices — directly usable by AI agents via the MCP server and SDK. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that AI agents specifically exercise the sandbox end-to-end, and explicit sandbox mode for the MCP server itself.
